environment.parent_io_root: RAMEN_NATIVE_TASK_EVIDENCE; separate actual corpus joined by nonce and bound CaseRecorder case

scope_binding.label: actual existing CaseRecorder case; nonempty <=128 ASCII lowercase/digits/underscore/hyphen
scope_binding.authority: label never enters native admission or selects a fault; no arbitrary path/bytes/identity setter

namespace.allocation: global checked ordinal under held cross-process budget lock, including reexec/helpers
namespace.path: case/closedScenario-runOrdinal; held no-follow directory traversal, exclusive creation
namespace.repeat: different actualRun/channel invocations each have one complete leaf; never segment oneRun
namespace.unarmed_witnesses: new unarmed children in same parentCase are separately tested, outside priorRun leaf coverage

admission: Reserve native control recording slot BEFORE native effects; release unused reservation on EAGAIN/no event.
Build bounded complete copied evidence outside Core/process locks. Reserve all knownRun file/entry/byte/row charges under actual held global budget lock BEFORE any output growth.
All writes exclusive no-follow,0600; directories0700. Preserve conservative reserved credits and partial files on failure; finish returns retainedRun, never complete.
Archive actual full stdout/stderr including under-capEOF; no sampling or silently dropped partial notifications.

scope.channel_generation: immutable actual admitted wire channel (0 unspawned); distinct from after snapshot enforcing revocation tombstone

metadata_fields.recording_complete: files complete only, never generic casepassed
metadata_fields.before/after: all declared snapshot fields; owners ordinary/reset are actual parent typed queue64+1. Separate core_ordinary_queue/core_reset_queue retain unchanged Core64 overflow-reset counters. offer_cursor is the actual non-authoritative carrier offer cursor; lifetime quotas are separate. owner_confirm_request/status record the actual owner-side consumed Confirm invocation, never a fabricated wire exchange. frame_surface_id/generation/epoch/live are read-only matching actual Core frame/surface facts; Surface.epoch and service_epoch share the same Core epoch domain. Pixels use exact raw references.
metadata_fields.syscalls: all declared actual syscall fields/origin/errno/credentials/ancillary ledger joins; DuplicateFd labels actual precharged F_DUPFD_CLOEXEC, normalized0/-1, source ledgerID and actual new alias descriptor facts
metadata_fields.objects: descriptorID + actual rawref; distinguish rejected mutable snapshot/prefix from immutable accepted object
metadata_fields.executable: actual declared held/source/exec descriptive identities; never whole1GiBVec
metadata_fields.processes: At most8 actual native process rows: parentPID, fork-derived childPID, nativebirthticks (null on failedread, never fake0proof), actual pidfd ledgerID, registered/held/executed artifact identities, actual sole-supervisor native/Rustidentity, actualwaitpid rawstatus and decodedoutcome, actualsupervisorjoin/quarantine. Join returnedexitproof+kernelSCMcredentials; no PIDpayload construction.
metadata_fields.referenced_processes: at most7 finalized ReferencedSibling scopes with actual parentCase/immutable channel/unarmed scenario-null, own native process and minimal fork/exec/pidfd/terminal-wait ledgers/descriptors/held executable. Copy after genuine sibling wait/join and zero owner charges; never merge into primary A ledgers.
